description: Lockheed L-188C Electra 0791/6-P-102 (c/n 1067, ex Braniff/TAN), naval maritime-patrol conversion delivered 6 November 1982; donated by the Navy and moved to the aeroclub on 28 November 2021, where it is being fitted out as a Patagonian aviation museum (photographed January 2023 and January 2025).

Lockheed L-188PF Electra 0790/6-P-103 (c/n 1070, ex Western/Evergreen), in naval service from 3 August 1983, stored at BAAZ from 1998; moved by road to the aeroclub in late 2024 (photographed January 2025).
Lockheed P-3B Orion 0871/6-P-55, donated by the Armada Argentina to the Municipality of Trelew and towed along Ruta 3 from Base Aeronaval Almirante Zar to the aeroclub on 14 June 2026.
